Roman Numeral Converter

Convert between 1-3999 and Roman numerals, both ways.

–
Result

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the conversion direction.
  2. Type a number (1-3999) or a Roman numeral.
  3. Press Convert.
  4. Non-canonical forms like IIII or VV are rejected with an error.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why only 1 to 3999?

Standard Roman numerals stop at 3999 because there is no standard single symbol for 5000 in basic notation. This tool converts integers from 1 to 3999.

How are invalid numerals like IIII rejected?

After parsing, the result is converted back to Roman and compared with the input. Forms like IIII, VV or IL fail this round-trip check and are rejected.

Can I convert Roman numerals back to numbers?

Yes — both directions are supported; pick the mode first.
